scene_selection: first 3 lexicographically sorted scene tokens in the existing validation metadata view; independent of calibration outcomes
observations: all physically available paired camera/LiDAR keyframes sorted by actual camera timestamps
perturbation: one camera-local isotropic Gaussian rotation per scene/camera/seed, held fixed across frames; camera-to-LiDAR R_corrupt=R_clean@Q, translation unchanged
weights: none; no weighted implementation or equivalence study
lidar_features: official get_corners per ring after stable azimuth ordering; exclude five points at each seam/end
